functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.tri_towers_board_deal_v2(b jsonb, at_ms bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE deck jsonb:=private.tri_towers_shuffle();
BEGIN
 RETURN (b-'result')||jsonb_build_object('deck',deck,'removed','[]'::jsonb,'cursor',29,'waste',deck->28,'run',0,
  'scoreBefore',coalesce((b->>'score')::integer,0),'phase','ready','deadline',at_ms+(b#>>'{rules,readyMs}')::bigint,
  'event',jsonb_build_object('label','Play a card or draw to start','points',0));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.boxdrop_required_rounds(second_score bigint)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT CASE WHEN second_score>=100000 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END $function$

boxdrop_board_deal
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.boxdrop_board_deal(b jsonb, at_ms bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE scales jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF b->'rules' IS DISTINCT FROM private.boxdrop_rules() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'boxdrop:rules_version';END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('stage',1,'target',32,'limit',6,'sum',0,'status','active','boxes','[]'::jsonb)) INTO scales FROM generate_series(1,4);
 RETURN private.boxdrop_fresh((b-ARRAY['result','startedAt','botVisited'])||jsonb_build_object(
  'phase','intro','deadline',at_ms+2500,'scoreBefore',coalesce((b->>'score')::bigint,0),'score',coalesce((b->>'score')::bigint,0),
  'scales',scales,'queue','[]'::jsonb,'recycleIndicator',6000,'completedFirstOrders',0,'closures',0,'recycleStreak',0,
  'firstOrderPoints',0,'closurePoints',0,'partialPoints',0,'serial',0,'freshDraws',0,'result',NULL,'event',jsonb_build_object('label','Get ready','points',0)));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.boxdrop_fresh(b jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE serial integer:=coalesce((b->>'serial')::integer,0)+1;
BEGIN
 RETURN b||jsonb_build_object('serial',serial,'freshDraws',coalesce((b->>'freshDraws')::integer,0)+1,
  'current',jsonb_build_object('id',serial,'value',1+private.boxdrop_random(11),'color',(ARRAY['red','blue','green','yellow'])[1+private.boxdrop_random(4)],'recycled',false));
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.tri_towers_bonus_qualified_v2(score bigint, rules jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT score >= (rules->>'bonusThreshold')::bigint $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.boxdrop_rules()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT '{"version":"boxdrop/1","stageMs":100000,"introMs":2500,"holdMs":9000,"clockStart":"intro_end","rounds":2,"bonusThreshold":100000,"maxRounds":3,"targets":[32,21],"slots":[6,3],"firstOrder":3200,"closureAwards":[5000,10000,15000,25000],"partialPerPoint":20,"recycleCapacity":6,"recyclePerSlot":1000,"speedStepMs":500,"speedPerStep":100,"bonusRequiresFirstOrder":true,"freshMin":1,"freshMax":11}'::jsonb
$function$

functions.name: boxdrop_visible
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.boxdrop_visible(s jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT (s-ARRAY['serial','freshDraws','botVisited'])||CASE WHEN s ? 'players' THEN jsonb_build_object('activePlayerId',s->'players'->(s->>'turnIndex')::integer->>'id') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.tri_towers_rules()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql

functions.name: tri_towers_visible
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.tri_towers_visible(s jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT (s-'deck')||jsonb_build_object('cards',(SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN private.tri_towers_exposed(s,i) THEN s->'deck'->i ELSE 'null'::jsonb END ORDER BY i) FROM generate_series(0,27) i),'stockRemaining',52-(s->>'cursor')::integer,
 'activePlayerId',CASE WHEN s->>'phase'='complete' THEN NULL ELSE s->'players'->(s->>'turnIndex')::integer->>'id' END)
$function$
